title: Armaan nikaalu tumhe parwan
body:
Armaan nikaalu , parwan chadaalu
tehro ali akber tumhe dulha to banaalu
Phal barchi ka khaaye hue sote ho zamee'n par
Ae laal kaleje ko mai kis tarha sambhaalu
<<DIVIDER>>
shaayad yuhi'n tham jaaye lahu zaqme jigar ka
utho ali akber mai kaleje se nikaalu
Ae laal tere byaah ka zainab ko tha armaa'n
In qoo'n bhare haato me mai mehndi to lagaalu
<<DIVIDER>>
Yu ghar se mere laal ko le jaaye'n na hazrat
Saaya karei'n aanchal ka mai behno ko bulaalu
Tehraao janaza mujhe hasrat to na reh jaaye
armaan bhare laal ka armaan nikaalu
<<DIVIDER>>
pehnake zara dekh lu poshak shahani
taboot pa phoolo ka mai sehra to chadhaalu
Shoukat pa zara rehm kar ae mout taharja
aankho se mazaare shahe mazloom lagaalu
